spanish: Y era como salir Moisés a la tienda, se levantaban todo el pueblo, y se plantaban varón abertura de su tienda, y miraban detrás de Moisés hasta su entrar a la tienda.
grammarChanges: se levantaba → se levantaban (h02033008006): kept the Qal imperfect 3rd-masculine-plural actor force instead of smoothing to a singular verb for the collective todo el pueblo, matching the plural se plantaban/miraban already in the sentence.
readerNote: Chose plural se levantaban over singular se levantaba so the actor stays all the people, as flagged, while todo el pueblo remains the written subject; this is a grammatical-agreement choice, not a meaning change.
